title: What failed old game would you fix?
author: klas-klattermus
selftext:
Imagine if you had a magical machine that could "repair broken games", which old game that disappointed back in the days would you fix so it lives up to its hype and how?

I'm considering Simon the sorcerer 3, the second one was nice but the third died from the "3D death" I guess, all the budget for shitty 3D

comments.author: CubersumGame
comments.body:
I would like to see Fallout 3 in the old isometric format.

I hope this will be implemented soon.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body:
Yeah fo1&2 were the best, but I wish we got another FoTBoS.
Edit: actually the latest wasteland game did that better that fallout ever could

replies.author: CubersumGame
replies.body: It honestly makes me quite sad to see people spending thousands of dollars on pointless game clones - like "I made a full copy of GTA with Claude" - instead of creating something truly valuable.

replies.author: revel911
replies.body: Why? If that is what they want.

replies.author: CubersumGame
replies.body: An exact copy makes no sense  - it already exists. It is literally a waste of time and tokens.

replies.author: bombero_kmn
replies.body:
I haven't tried this yet but it popped up in my feed a few hours ago and looks neat: 

https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/mods/109717

I know its FO4 but maybe something for 3/NV could be derived from it?

replies.author: CubersumGame
replies.body:
No, it’s just the camera being positioned further back.

I’m referring to that old engine (for instance, the \*Fallout Community Edition\* project is working on this).

replies.author: revel911
replies.body: I would love to see Vice City in the GTA 1/2 style.

replies.author: CubersumGame
replies.body: True, true. I do not really like 1-2 style actually but it had a charm.

comments.author: ffktiv
comments.body: Definitely Fuel. One of a kind.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: I'm not a motor man but that looks pretty good, why did it fail?

replies.author: ffktiv
replies.body:
I think it kind of went under the radar. Games for windows live integration also had something to do with it. A few janky mechanics too like being owned most of the race and catching up to enemies near the finish line. Kind of a dead world too.

But the game was wild for its time. Procedural generation with a fixed seed, huge map, plenty of variety.

comments.author: 0bscuris
comments.body: I’m working on gangsters organized crime now, but high on my hit list is the old sacrifice and overlord games.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: Yeah that one could be nice with some better environments

replies.author: sirpalee
replies.body: And less bugs. I think the concept of physics based, hardcore survival with dinosaurs is amazing. If it was released in the 2010s or 2020s it could have been amazing.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body:
Yeah, I tried to get into Arc but it's too "open" if you know what I mean. I'd like trespasser to be more like Horizon Zero Dawn but actual dinosaurs in a Jurassic park setting.
Heck I really liked Dino Crisis for PlayStation back in the days, dinosaurs are underrated

comments.author: reh-dit-causes-aids
comments.body: make spore what it should have been.

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: Daikatana? Romero can finally make you his bitch, with the aid of ai!

comments.author: Geoton99
comments.body: Gears & Guts, it was an old Glu mobile game

comments.author: vukassin
comments.body:
With all attention the already great games are getting, really I would love to see more AI necromancy raising something horrid back from the dead.  
  
Hear me out... LImbo of the Lost but with Ai assets instead of stolen ones xD   
Gothic 3, lots of potential, lots of complaints.   
Boiling Point road to hell and games from same company, horribly janky and flawed but there is potential.   
Fixing Brigand Oaxaca would be impressive.   
Two Worlds 1 and 2  
Starfield

Going through bad games:  
Drake of the 99 dragons  
Tomb Raider Angel of Darkness  
Postal 3  
Any gta clone from the period: Driver 3, True Crime NY City, 25 to life, NARC, Godfather, Scarface... If anything merging them all into a one engine would be possible  
*Ride To Hell: Retribution*.  
Sonic 06

There are also a lot of Assassins Creed and Watchdogs games, similar style of bland open world. So not a bad game... but different flavors of cardboard that I would be curious if AI could somehow tweak and rework to have more to chew on and less tower climbing.

comments.author: count023
comments.body:
netstorm, that game had such potential and just needed a bit of TLC. 

Same with deadlock 2, abandoning the build in windows inerface for a custom one that was a fraction of the resolution of the screens at the time really killed that games playability. Both would play great as browser games today.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: I totally missed out on those. I like the idea of deadlock 2 but two thirds of the screen being UI is a bit heavy

comments.author: jpewaqs
comments.body: Qabbalah - fix the locations of items

comments.author: Entropydemic
comments.body:
I wish I could redo Unleash Blading, cut out all the bullshit story, and just have dungeons and progressive gearing. I'd leave in the gacha but not for money using game currency for starting new characters and weapon leveling. I think you can still find the APK but the game was shut down some time ago.

I'd also love a bot match version of Super Mecha Champions. It was a wonderful game but died and they put Once Human in its place.

comments.author: derLeisemitderLaute
comments.body: I would overhaul Majesty 2. It is a cool game but way too hard. It sometimes feel more like a Eurogame where you have to do the exact decisions in the exact time and order and you are then still dependent on luck

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: Some indies just released two majesty 2 "clones", have you tried any of those?

replies.author: derLeisemitderLaute
replies.body: I didnt heard about that. Do you remember the names per chance? I would definitely give them a try!

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: Sorry I don't remember, they should be less than a year old and probably show up with some simple google searches for "new games like Majesty 2" or something
